questions.prompt: Which verse, in the source’s Ibrahim example, demonstrates submission to God?
options: The angels prostrated except Iblees, who was arrogant and among the unbelievers.
Those who had faith and righteous deeds will have gardens beneath which rivers flow.
When his Lord said “Submit”, he said “I have submitted to the Lord of the worlds.”
questions.note: The question specifically asks for Ibrahim’s response in Quran 2:131. The original gives Arabic and English versions of each option; the English meanings are retained here.

questions.prompt: What is the meaning of applied ethics?
options: The ethics that should be applied in our life.
Normative ethics applicable in different fields.
questions.note: Lesson 2, p. 5 defines application of moral principles in a particular field. B is more precise than A; applied ethics is not simply identical to theoretical inquiry.

questions.prompt: When the Prophet says “Seek knowledge even in China”:
options: He means that you have to travel to that country for learning.
China is an example: even if learning requires travel a very long distance, you should pursue it.

questions.note: Lesson 3, p. 7 uses this saying to reject geographic restriction. This tests the course’s intended interpretation; it does not assert independent authentication of the saying’s transmission.
